caption:
18 days until the August SAT.

Every quadratic question on the SAT asks for one of four things: the zeros, the maximum, the minimum, or where it meets a line. Desmos hands you all four without factoring, completing the square, or the quadratic formula.

Save this one — it's the whole topic in one place. Seva's practice tests have the same calculator built in, so you can drill these until they're reflex. Free trial — link in bio.
